name: Junk Mail
source:
With a bitter tongue and a heart running on empty, Harriet sleepwalks through her first day of university, stuck in a degree she doesn't care about. 

She expects nothing from it – until someone proves her wrong.

[From [url=https://xxep.itch.io/junk-mail-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
带着苦涩的舌头和空虚的心，哈丽特稀里糊涂地度过了大学的第一天，困在她并不关心的学位上。

她对此没有任何期望——直到有人证明她错了。

[来自[url=https://xxep.itch.io/junk-mail-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
